claims.statement: Directive (EU) 2023/970 grants pay-information rights and phases gender-pay-gap reporting obligations by employer size.
The Commission summarizes the directive as including pre-employment pay information and reporting for employers with at least 100 workers.

contrary_evidence: Payroll suites and major consultancies are natural incumbents and national transpositions may produce fragmented requirements.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through payroll bureaux, employment-law firms, and employer associations.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 350 employers at 18000 PLN annual revenue creates 6.3 million PLN ARR by year five and can place a majority founder stake above 5 million PLN without double-counting accumulated cash.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3-4 founder hours daily on models and partner enablement while employment lawyers own interpretation.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 70-80% gross margin after payroll ingestion, legal QA, and bureau revenue share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: one 18000 PLN employer cycle repays a 12000 PLN bureau onboarding effort.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 18000 PLN per annual employer cycle plus 300 PLN per material job-family update.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual reporting, worker information requests, reorganizations, and hiring-range changes recur.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Anonymized job mappings, explanations, and remediation outcomes improve comparable-role benchmarks
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded payroll-bureau workflow and employment-law partner referral
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Explainable pay-gap and job-equivalence evidence service sold per annual cycle
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The employer pays when management signs an evidence pack or updated range map
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An annual reporting cycle, worker request, or job-family change occurs

founder_fit: Quantitative analysis, standardized delivery, and accountant-like channels avoid public-facing selling and fit part-time execution.
risks: Bad job-equivalence recommendations can create discrimination exposure, requiring explainability, lawyer review, and human sign-off.

structure.control_point: The normalized job-family map used for pay-gap reporting and management sign-off
structure.critical_dependency: Payroll-bureau data feeds and defensible gender-neutral job-equivalence methodology

thesis: Embed an explainable job-equivalence and remediation workflow in payroll bureaux, charging employers for each annual cycle and hiring-range update while aggregating lawful benchmark statistics on adjustment outcomes.
title: EqualPay Annual Evidence Cycle
uncertainties: The conversion rate from payroll-bureau introduction to a premium annual evidence cycle is unknown.
